description: Deterministic GLEIF public-authority vet conformance vectors — the cross-impl convergence target for a real DACS-2 verification recipe (PATH-OS Labs <-> DNO <-> any SDK impl). Each case maps a GLEIF response (HTTP status, or a parsed registration status) to the §7.5.1 decision a conformant verifier MUST produce. These encode the Mode-A semantics locked with DNO in DACS-Standard #146. Deterministic by construction (no live fetch) so two impls converge on the same verdicts.
notes: decision enum is §7.5.1 four-value: pass | fail | indeterminate | error (never collapsed).
fetch-level (before reading the record): 404 not-found -> fail (conclusive); any other non-2xx / error body -> error (verification could-not-complete, NOT a verdict).

registration-status (parsed record), source-grounded against LEI-CDF 3.1 (DNO #146 convergence): ISSUED -> pass; LAPSED + RETIRED -> indeterminate (lifecycle-end states GLEIF treats as still-valid-but-not-current, not a conclusive contradiction); ANNULLED + DUPLICATE + CANCELLED -> fail (GLEIF assignment-error states); any other/absent (incl MERGED) -> indeterminate (authority answered, non-binary).
RETIRED resolved fail->indeterminate to converge with DNO's LEI-CDF 3.1 grounding (it reads like LAPSED, not like the assignment-error states).
entity-name normalization for resolvedEntity comparison: NFC + trim + collapse-internal-whitespace (no NFKC / case-fold / accent-strip).

expected.note: no fetch-level verdict — proceed to the registration-status cases
